Query:
  query INDEX READS [options]
      Compute matching statistics for every read in READS (FASTA, FASTQ,
      or one sequence per line; - for stdin).  Writes one line per read:
      its name, a tab, and its values, space-separated (QUERY_OUTPUT.md).
      A summary goes to stderr.  Results and their order do not depend on
      the thread count.
    -o FILE                  write to FILE (default stdout); FILE.gz is gzipped
    -p N, --threads N        query on N threads (default 0: every CPU)
    --gzip-level LEVEL       gzip level for .gz output, 0 to 9 (default 1)
    --ftab FILE              start reads KLEN steps in from a stored ftab
                             (ftab-build); it must be built from INDEX
    --build-ftab[=KLEN]      build an ftab of KLEN-mers after loading
                             (default KLEN 14)
    --mode min|psi|phi|dual  how repositions compute LCEs: min reads the LCP
                             minima of a min index; psi compares the read
                             with the candidate's suffix using psi; phi takes
                             whole rows' LCP minima from the index's LCP
                             summaries and walks phi only over the current
                             row; dual does as phi, and where the summaries
                             leave a side open, races a psi walk against
                             phi's.  min needs a min index, psi a psi, full
                             or psi-locate index, phi a phi or full index,
                             and dual a full index.  The default is min on a
                             min index, phi on a phi index, and psi
                             otherwise.
  needs a phi, full or psi-locate index:
    --positions              add a field with an occurrence position for each
                             value (-1 where it is 0)
    --report ms|smem-one|smem-all
                             ms (default) adds nothing; smem-one adds the
                             read's SMEMs as i:L:p; smem-all writes SMEMs as
                             ropebwt3 mem -p does, one line each
    --min-smem-len L         report SMEMs of length L or more, as ropebwt3's
                             -l L (default 1: all)
    --max-smem-positions MAXPOS
                             smem-all lists at most MAXPOS positions per SMEM
                             (default: all), as ropebwt3's -p

Ftabs (FTAB_FORMAT.md):
  ftab-build INDEX FTAB [--kmer-len KLEN | --auto] [-p N]
      Build an index's ftab, a table of the query state after each KLEN-mer
      over ACGT, and write it to FTAB.  --auto (the default) takes the
      largest KLEN whose table fits in 5% of the index file, then steps
      down while fewer than 80% of its KLEN-mers occur.  -p as for query.
  ftab-verify INDEX FTAB [--crc]
      Check from the headers that FTAB was built from INDEX; --crc also
      checks its payload CRC-32s.
  ftab-info FTAB
      Print an ftab's header.

Index files (INDEX_FORMAT.md):
  index-plan INDEX [--mode M] [--positions] [--report R]
      Print an index's header and what each query loads, and its RAM; with
      query options, for that query alone.
  index-verify INDEX
      Check every section's CRC-32 and that the file is whole.
  index-add-seq-ids INDEX SEQ_IDS OUT
      Write INDEX, a psi, phi, full or psi-locate index, to OUT with the
      sequence-ID table SEQ_IDS (see build --seq-ids), copying its other
      sections unchanged.
  index-psi-locate INDEX OUT
      Write INDEX, a full index with phi_inv, to OUT as a psi-locate index
      (see build --layout), copying every section but PHI_LEN unchanged.

Run 'ms2 --help-advanced' for development and advanced options.
